subject_session: Achilles-10252013, Cicero-09012014, Gatsby-08022013, Buddy-06272013 (4 linear-track sessions)

headline_stat.name: fraction of CA1 place cells with significant theta phase precession (shuffle p<0.05)

stated_limitation: the other two assets in the dandiset use a circular maze whose linearization is not directly comparable and are excluded

justification.dataset: DANDI:000044 (Grosmark & Buzsaki hc-11), dorsal CA1 silicon-probe recordings on a linear track, the canonical dataset for theta entrainment and precession.
justification.handling: Real files streamed via LINDI with correct epoch/run detection, explicit handling of two NWB conversion quirks (period-stored-as-rate, NaN-gated linearization), and defensible unit/occupancy/rate quality filters.
justification.analysis: Rayleigh test for phase locking, Kempter circular-linear regression with a 200-permutation phase-shuffle null, plus an LFP-independent autocorrelogram-rhythmicity confirmation and dual-oscillator frequency check; circular statistics used correctly throughout.
justification.correctness: Every headline number (81%/n=155, 97%/n=67, MRL 0.145/0.223, 65/98 significant, 62 negative, -206 deg median, per-session 64-69%) reproduces exactly from the committed CSV and is internally consistent and physically possible.
justification.figures: Figures show the effect unambiguously with labeled units and sample sizes, and example cells are chosen by correlation strength (|rho|) rather than fitted slope.
justification.honesty: Claims are proportionate to a genuinely clean, strong result with no disqualifying acts, but the write-up names no specific limitation of this result beyond noting the excluded circular-maze sessions.
justification.verdict: A sophisticated, fully reproducible, correctly controlled demonstration of both theta entrainment and phase precession that I would accept as-is.
